entities.name: Query beta-mannosidase
observations: 768 aa sequence; calculated molecular mass 86.43 kDa and theoretical pI 5.31.
Has Glyco_hydro_2_N2 (PF22666), Glyco_hydro_2 (PF00703), and C-terminal Mannosidase_ig (PF17786) domains.
Matches Aspergillus fumigatus beta-mannosidase A Q4WMS9 at 100% identity over 100% query coverage; E-value 0.
Likely secreted fungal glycosidase, although the provided sequence is shorter than the 926-aa reference target and lacks a clear N-terminal signal peptide in the displayed residues.

entities.name: Q4WMS9 beta-mannosidase A
observations: Reviewed Aspergillus fumigatus protein annotated as beta-mannosidase A, EC 3.2.1.25.
Hydrolyzes terminal non-reducing beta-linked mannose residues from beta-mannosidic oligosaccharides; participates in mannan, galactomannan, and N-glycan degradation.
Annotated as secreted and homodimeric; active-site proton donor at reference position 474.
GO annotations include beta-mannosidase activity, extracellular region, carbohydrate metabolic process, and glycoprotein catabolic process.

entities.name: Beta-mannoside hydrolysis
observations: Hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing beta-D-mannose residues in beta-D-mannosides; assigned to beta-mannosidase EC 3.2.1.25.

entities.name: Fungal glycan degradation
observations: Beta-mannosidase A homologs are annotated in glycan metabolism, including polymeric mannan, galactomannan, and N-glycan degradation.
